subject: Offensive security report + CAIQ intake — redaction, artifacts and remediation timeline
messages:
From: Paul Atkins <paul.atkins@helioshealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: GRC Portal <grc@helioshealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Offsec report required for CAIQ intake - redaction and acceptance criteria

Hi Vivek + Marissa,

Thanks for the quick work on the CAIQ questionnaire. Our compliance team has flagged the SIG/CAIQ submission that requires a copy of your most recent offensive security assessment (red-team / penetration test) as an artifact. Can you confirm whether you can provide: (a) a redacted full technical report (PII and customer-identifying data removed) or (b) an executive summary plus signed attestation?

We have the following constraints from procurement:
- The uploaded artifact must be a PDF (no password-protected files).
- Evidence should include a short remediation timeline for high/critical findings (approx. 1 page).
- A contact listed for follow-up questions during intake.

Can you let us know which option you prefer and an ETA for upload to our GRC portal (https://grc.helioshealth.com/portal/cases/2739)? We are aiming to close the CAIQ by end of week.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Atkins
Head of Vendor Risk
Helios Health
paul.atkins@helioshealth.com

Attachment: none
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Paul Atkins <paul.atkins@helioshealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, GRC Portal <grc@helioshealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 14:02:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Offsec report required for CAIQ intake - redaction and acceptance criteria

Paul —

Appreciate the note. We can provide a redacted full technical report (preferred for transparency) plus a one-page remediation summary and an attestation letter. Proposed plan: 

1) Today: kick off redaction with our external RedTeam vendor and produce a PDF with customer identifiers removed. We will follow your rule about non-password PDFs.
2) By tomorrow EOD (Mon 14 Jun, 15:00 UTC): upload redacted report + remediation summary + signed attestation to your GRC portal.
3) We will include a named contact (Marissa Cole) for intake follow-ups.

Questions: do you need DocuSign for the attestation or is a signed PDF sufficient? Also confirm whether the portal needs the report split into executive + technical or a single combined PDF.

I am looping in Marissa (security lead) and Hannah (compliance) for redaction and upload coordination. We will attach our internal redaction checklist for visibility.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: redaction-guidelines.docx (internal checklist)
From: RedTeam Ops <ops@redteam.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, Paul Atkins <paul.atkins@helioshealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 18:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Offsec report required for CAIQ intake - redaction and acceptance criteria

Vivek / Marissa —

We completed the primary redaction pass on the June 2027 engagement. Summary:
- We removed customer names, email addresses, API keys, and screenshots that contained live customer data.
- Technical appendices that reference internal hostnames were generalized (host-###).
- Full reproduction steps for low-severity issues were left in to preserve technical context; we can further redact if Helios requests.

We are attaching the redacted report (offsec-full-report-redacted-helio.pdf) for your review. Note: the report still contains raw stack traces and proof-of-concept snippets for critical issues — those are standard but can be sanitized if you prefer a more executive-facing document.

Open items from our side:
- HIGH: Stored credentials in internal build system (Finding A). We recommended a fix and have a mitigation ETA of 2 weeks from remediation ticket creation.
- CRITICAL: Privilege escalation via legacy orchestration endpoint (Finding B). This requires code patch + emergency rollout; the recommended SLA from our team is 72 hours once the code patch is ready.

We can produce either a single combined PDF (technical + executive front matter) or split files. From experience, GRC portals accept either — Helios often prefers combined with an appended one-page remediation summary.

Best,
Alex Romero
Operations Lead, RedTeam Ops
ops@redteam.ai

Attachment: offsec-full-report-redacted-helio.pdf (3.2 MB)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Paul Atkins <paul.atkins@helioshealth.com>, GRC Portal <grc@helioshealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, RedTeam Ops <ops@redteam.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final upload plan — redacted offensive report + remediation summary (Helios CAIQ)

Paul / Helios GRC —

Confirming our upload plan and artifacts for the CAIQ intake: 

Artifacts being uploaded at 15:00 UTC on Mon 14 Jun (expected processing window 15:00–16:00 UTC):
- offsec-full-report-redacted-helio.pdf (combined technical + executive, redacted)
- remediation-summary-helio.txt (one-page remediation timeline for HIGH/CRITICAL findings)
- signed-attestation.pdf (signed PDF attesting to redaction and authenticity)

Notes on remediation:
- Ticket SIT-4523 has been opened with engineering for the HIGH finding; current target for patch deployment is 2027-06-28. Details: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SIT-4523
- CRITICAL finding will be treated as emergency priority; we will notify Helios via the contact below once the fix is deployed.

Marissa will appear as the named intake contact for follow-ups (marissa_cole@redwood.com). If Helios requires a different file format or DocuSign for the attestation please let us know ASAP so we can adjust prior to the 15:00 UTC upload window.

Thanks for the coordination — please confirm receipt of this plan so we can proceed with the upload.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: remediation-summary-helio.txt, signed-attestation.pdf
